summary.en:
- Fugue is a Break focused debuffer. By just being on the team, all the Toughness Reduction dealt will be converted into one instance of 100% Super Break DMG.
- On top of that, all enemies will get an exo-toughness; whenever an enemy's Toughness bar has been brought to 0, an additional (weaker) bar will appear (both bars can be broken at once).
- Her skill designates 1 ally, increasing their Break Effect% and making them able to deal 50% of original the Toughness Reduction, even if the enemy does not have the corresponding Weakness. Whenever this ally attacks, Fugue has a chance to decrease the hit enemy's DEF.

details.en:
- E2 grants teamwide action advance equivalent to S5 Dance! Dance! Dance! and gains Energy whenever an enemy's Weakness gets broken.
- E1 provides 50% Weakness Break Efficiency.
- S1 provides self Break Effect% and Break Vulnerability on enemies who's Weakness has been Broken, but her E1 and E2 are far more valuable, especially because she has great alternative options.
